summary.name: Subler
summary.one_liner: Subler is a macOS application for muxing and tagging MP4 files, including subtitle creation and iTunes-style metadata editing.
use_cases: Adding subtitle tracks to MP4 files for Apple devices
Combining video, audio, and subtitles from MKV or MOV into MP4
Tagging movies and TV episodes with iTunes-style metadata
Converting VobSub or SCC captions for MP4 playback
summary.what_it_does: Subler creates TX3G and WebVTT subtitle tracks compatible with Apple devices such as iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, iPod, and QuickTime. It muxes video, audio, chapters, subtitles, and closed caption tracks from MOV, MP4, and MKV files into MP4. It also imports raw streams including H.264 elementary streams, AAC, AC3, Scenarist SCC, and VobSub IDX. Users can edit full iTunes-style metadata and look up movie and TV show metadata from TheMovieDB, TVDB, and the iTunes Store.
notable: Creates TX3G and WebVTT subtitle tracks compatible with Apple devices
Metadata lookup via TheMovieDB, TVDB, and iTunes Store
